nights.title: Karsu
nights.name: Karsu
nights.extract: Karsu Dönmez, known mononymously as Karsu, is a Turkish-Dutch singer, pianist and composer. While her music style is a blend of various genres, jazz pop is probably the best description for it. She has songs in Dutch, English, and Turkish.

en.who: Karsu Dönmez, known mononymously as Karsu, is a Turkish-Dutch singer, pianist and composer. Her music blends several genres, and jazz pop is probably the best description for it. Her songs are in Dutch, English and Turkish.
facts: Karsu is a Turkish-Dutch singer, pianist and composer.
She has songs in Dutch, English and Turkish.

de.who: Karsu Dönmez, bekannt als Karsu, ist eine türkisch-niederländische Sängerin, Pianistin und Komponistin. Ihre Musik verbindet mehrere Genres, am ehesten lässt sie sich als Jazz-Pop beschreiben. Ihre Songs sind auf Niederländisch, Englisch und Türkisch.
facts: Karsu ist eine türkisch-niederländische Sängerin, Pianistin und Komponistin.
Ihre Songs sind auf Niederländisch, Englisch und Türkisch.

tr.who: Karsu Dönmez, Karsu adıyla bilinir ve Türk-Hollandalı bir şarkıcı, piyanist ve bestecidir. Müziği birçok türün karışımıdır ve bunu en iyi anlatan tanım muhtemelen jazz pop'tur. Şarkılarının sözleri Hollandaca, İngilizce ve Türkçedir.
